reason: The eligibility pre-check is the one thing I actually want, because I lost an hour today on exactly that kind of call, but I am not signing a 12-month contract and handing 1,200 EUR up front to a one-person side project with no portfolio, no references and a founder who does this 10 hours a week around a day job. I have been left with a dead site and nobody answering the phone before.
objection: Who maintains the automations in a year when the founder gets a promotion or a baby? The launch price for the first two clients tells me nobody is running this yet, and my clients' documents sit on a system I cannot vouch for.
would_change_my_mind: Two named consulting firms in Romania who have been live on it for at least six months, that I can call myself, plus a written continuity clause: if support stops, I get the automations handed over in a form my own IT person can run.
